boundary_decomposition.latency: each provider receives the complete residual after deterministic common and branch-ingress latency because provider branches compose by max
boundary_decomposition.cost: residual execution-cost budget after deterministic fixed stages is split equally across the three required providers because provider costs compose additively
boundary_decomposition.quality: each provider inherits global q_min because composed quality is the minimum across required providers and deterministic fixed stages are quality-neutral

freeze_rule: Do not mark Phase3A frozen until structural tests pass, exact v2-derived local queries are human-reviewed, and the real decision-time horizon-alignment audit is resolved or explicitly scoped as an approximation condition.
